from pathlib import Path
program = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs/task-12cb42e7.py')
program.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program.write_text('def transform(grid):\n    return [[7 if value == 5 else 0 if value == 7 else value for value in row] for row in grid]\n')
# Verify saved implementation reproduces the received demo pair.
ns = {}
exec(program.read_text(), ns)
demo_in = [[5]*7 for _ in range(27)]
demo_in[0][3] = 7
demo_in[3][6] = 7
demo_out = ns['transform'](demo_in)
assert demo_out[0][3] == 0 and demo_out[3][6] == 0
assert all(demo_out[r][c] == 7 for r in range(27) for c in range(7) if (r,c) not in {(0,3),(3,6)})
print(program, 'verified')
